threat_model.untrusted: A launched restricted CLI, its model-directed descendants, and bytes carried by the Node service connection
threat_model.boundary: None of those sources may obtain User authority by selecting a caller value, host mode, path, PID, service capability, or reusable ticket
threat_model.outside_scope: An already unrestricted same-user process outside the launched CLI; it has the user's existing filesystem rights and does not create a new privilege boundary

direct_source_facts: The current Tauri product runtime starts Node, and Node NativeHostClient.attach starts native-host; the host observes only the service pipe source.
The current native-host holds one verified ProductDatabase connection and handles one service connection until Shutdown.
L0's v37 request wire has no caller or grant fields; the R2 service capability authenticates service only.
Node connectExisting now exists as a service-only transport but is not wired into product startup.
implementation_boundary: Tauri starts and retains the exact native-host process object and its existing product root and resource custody; Node connects to that host as service only.
A separate User pipe accepts only the native-observed current-user Tauri process object pinned for this host lifetime; the host also checks that process remains live before accepting an operation.
Tauri verifies that the User pipe server is the native-host process it launched and still retains before sending a complete request.
The Tauri command surface accepts only explicit local product actions; it does not proxy arbitrary Node requests into User operations.
The User, service and seat channels carry origin facts to one main-thread authority executor using one RootLock and one verified database connection.
Each v37 operation rechecks its current grant, generation, scope and host epoch; a prior receipt cannot bypass current authority.
The legacy R2 owning-client mode keeps its existing Shutdown and stop semantics; a shared-host service disconnect does not end the User-owned host.
logical_check: An inherited stdin handle, command-line mode, parent PID or image path alone is not User proof. Windows permits an explicit parent process attribute. Mutual comparison of live process objects and a dedicated source channel supplies the missing product-origin fact within the recorded AppContainer threat boundary; it does not prove a human click or resist an unrestricted same-user process.
direct_checks_required: A real Tauri command reaches a User-only native operation exactly once, while the same bytes on the Node service pipe are rejected with no database write or process launch.
A distinct same-user process and a restricted CLI descendant cannot enter the User pipe; no User write handle is inherited by Node or CLI.
A Tauri-verified User pipe server is the exact retained native-host process; process exit before acceptance fails closed.
Node connect-only close leaves the host and active seat alive; the legacy R2 owning client still closes through Shutdown.
A host restart changes epoch, invalidates old channels, and preserves UNKNOWN custody until direct recovery evidence exists.
